description: List, read, transcribe, or store meeting and voice transcripts. `list` shows stored transcript captures (newest first); `show` reads one capture back (pass `meeting_id`, or omit it to read the active capture; `last` returns only the final N lines). `transcribe` turns an audio file into text with the configured speech-to-text provider. `status` reports which speech-to-text provider is configured and whether a capture is active. `import` stores transcript text as a capture so `list` and `show` can read it back later.
name: transcripts

action.description: What to do: list captures, show one, transcribe an audio file, report status, or import transcript text.

file.description: Audio file to transcribe (for `transcribe`). Absolute path, or relative to the workspace.

last.description: For `show`: return only the last N lines of the capture.

meeting_id.description: Capture id from `list` (for `show`); for `import`, an optional label for the stored capture. Omit `meeting_id` on `show` to read the active capture.

model.description: Optional speech-to-text model override for `transcribe` (provider default otherwise).
